name: Bybit linear BTCUSDT ticker state (mark, index, funding, open interest)
description: Bybit v5 tickers.BTCUSDT on the linear (USDT perpetual) public socket, pushed every 100 ms as a snapshot followed by deltas that carry only changed keys. The adapter folds deltas onto the last snapshot and emits one complete normalized state row per admitted message, so every declared field is present on every event; update_kind records whether the underlying message was a snapshot or a delta. A delta arriving before any snapshot is not applied and raises AwaitingSnapshot with RecoveryAction::Reconnect; a snapshot missing any declared field is refused rather than folded, and a reconnect voids the folded state. cross_sequence is the envelope cs and is the declared ordering key: a message whose cs is below the admitted frontier is an OutOfOrder notice and is not applied, an equal cs is a Duplicate. event_time is the envelope ts. Bybit's basis and basisRate keys are deliberately not modelled: they are documented for dated futures and are not relied on for the perpetual, and the derived signal computes basis from mark and index itself. openInterestValue is carried for cross-checking only; the signal computes notional from open_interest_base and mark_price so both venues share one formula. expected_heartbeat_ms is 20000, a cadence bound: the venue pushes this surface at least every 20 s, so a longer silence is genuine staleness. Rights-gated: the Bybit row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md is unverified and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit.
